name: Johnson Metal Works
old_description: Whether you’re creating a production run of components, an architectural element for a construction project, or need help bringing a napkin sketch to life, Johnson Metal Works has your back. With our experts in metal fabrication and design, you are limited only by your imagination, and sometimes not even that!
about:
Johnson Metal Works, operating as JMW, is a metal fabrication shop based in Bozeman, Montana. The company provides custom metal fabrication services including sheet and tube laser cutting, forming, finishing, and field dimensioning.

The shop specializes in custom-fabricated metal components using steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, with CNC equipment capable of cutting aluminum up to 3/8 inch thick. Core processes include design engineering for manufacturability, structural and industrial fabrication, architectural metalwork, and welded assemblies. A rotary-index tube laser enables precision cutting of complex profiles with repeatability that reduces fabrication time. The facility produces frames, supports, railings, canopies, trusses, and complex profiles for OEM parts and repeatable production runs.

Johnson Metal Works serves OEM, architectural, structural, construction, and industrial markets. Its components appear in architectural facades, interior partitions, shade structures, HVAC and mechanical support systems, commercial and residential furniture, lighting installations, stair components, and transport and industrial trailers. The company also fabricates metal casings and protective cages for machinery.

The company's stated mission is to “Empower” customers through design engineering that optimizes parts for cost-effectiveness and quality. Differentiators include the rotary-index tube laser for complex tube profiles, CNC cutting of thick aluminum, and field dimensioning services to ensure fit-up on site.
